svg.title: mwm2: two displays
svg.desc: Two displays side by side. Holding Left Option, a terminal is dragged across the edge the displays share without tiling, then dropped on the right display's outer edge to tile to its right half. A resize dragged toward the other display stops at the window's own display.

g.text: Drag between displays. The edge they share doesn't tile.
Resizes stop at their own display.
